title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 199 (Effect of ratifying unauthorized act forming part of a transaction)

content.overview: A person ratifying any unauthorized act done on his behalf ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part.
content.glance: Ratifying any unauthorized act ratifies the whole transaction of which it formed a part.
content.study: A person ratifying any unauthorized act done on his behalf ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part. Partial ratification of a transaction is not available; adoption of part adopts the whole.

sections.heading: Ratification of unauthorized act
sections.body: Person ratifies an unauthorized act done on his behalf.

sections.heading: Whole transaction ratified
sections.body: The whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part is ratified.

provisions.title: Effect of ratifying unauthorized act forming part of a transaction

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 199 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Identify the unauthorized act and the larger transaction; conclude that ratification of the act ratifies the whole transaction.

examTips: No partial ratification of a transaction.
